name: kotlin-lib
description: Answers Kotlin/Java library questions from the real published sources jar — resolved signatures, KDoc, dependency tree and source search — instead of recalling them.

java.title: Java executable
java.description: The java command of a JDK 25 or later (a JRE is not enough). Leave it as java to use the one on PATH, or give the full path to the executable inside the JDK home, <JDK home>/bin/java — C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-25\bin\java.exe, /usr/lib/jvm/jdk-25/bin/java — not the JDK home itself.

server_version.title: Server version
server_version.description: Which released server build to run: 'latest' (checked once a day) or a pinned version such as 0.9.0.
